Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first search attempt (Step 1), the WebSurfer agent failed to extract the exact decision date from the available search results. The search result for "Selle v. Gibb decision date" clearly showed the text "The decision date for the case Selle v. Gibb was July 23, 1984. Wikipedia" in the viewport. However, instead of extracting this explicit date, the agent only noted that the search "found a result stating..." without capturing the specific date in its analysis or metadata. This failure to extract the concrete date from the first available source forced the agent into a cycle of redundant searches for both cases, delaying the verification of the obvious answer (that Reynolds v. Sims, decided in 1964, was first). The agent repeatedly failed to utilize the information present in the viewport, leading to an inefficient process and a lack of precise data extraction in the initial step.
